title: What Is Seattle Reading?
description: Explore millions of Seattle Public Library checkouts — search any author or title to see when a book surged in popularity, and browse the most-borrowed authors and works by genre.
keywords: seattle public library, books, checkouts, data, authors, titles, genres
dek: The Seattle Public Library logs millions of checkouts a year. Search an author or title to see when a book surged in popularity — or explore the most-borrowed authors and works by genre.
note: Based on a sample of SPL open checkout data, 2018–2022.
